title.zh: IBM、甲骨文等4家企业反对OKX、ICE未经同意代币化其股票，反对企业总数升至26家

current_state.zh: IBM, Oracle, Intel and IonQ objected to OKX and ICE tokenizing their stocks without consent under the SEC innovation exemption, bringing the total number of opposing companies to 26.
